doc.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013

chapter: Harlem Blues and Jazz Band and touring
title: Touring overseas with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band
summary: Trips to Scandinavia, Russia, Denmark and Macau and how audiences respond.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Those groups have shrunk now, a lot of them, for the touring. And have you traveled overseas with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band?

Oh yes. We’ve been to Sweden practically every year, and Norway. Another magical job was in — oh God, it’s a tourist place in Denmark. Oh what is it? Sorry, the memory. But that was magical. Beautiful little theater in a park. What is the name? Please forgive me. I don’t want to tell you what it is — early Alzheimer’s.
Well the audiences, are they different overseas?

I think they are different. I would say they’re different. They’re very receptive. Not only there, we’ve been to Russia several times, traveled all over, from one end to the other, which Russia is huge from the east coast to the west coast. You could look over and see China from Vladivostok or whatever the heck it is. But I’m still trying to think of the name of that theater.
Tivoli Gardens? I think it is — no Tivoli is in England, right?
Do you get to go? © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
[Ruth’s husband] Yeah. But I have to pay my way.

He’s been a few times, yeah. Yeah, it’s been lovely working with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band, yeah. The last place we went was Macau, that was so rewarding, we had such a wonderful time. And outside. We had to land in Hong Kong, then take a ferry to the Macau. Lovely, lovely place. I had a wonderful time.
It must be hard to decide what you have to charge in order to pay everybody and pay all those plane tickets and all that.

Yes, yes. It’s a lot of money for the people to put out who bring us over there. Yes. Oh and another place, St. Petersburg, oh my God is that a beautiful city in Russia. And we’ve done in theater there and outside in the park. It was really wonderful.
